work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. III at 46406, its synopsis and the actual Alexander protocol at 46427–46428 identify a complete act with proem and four clauses through 46602, dating at 46604–46609 and its marginal tail at 46612–46615; IV begins at 46618. The historical dating correction at 46420–46422 belongs to the preceding act's marker at 46399 and is excluded as a clean separate LF range. The conventional closing derogation/publication etc. at 46598, 46600 and 46602 remains literal. The frozen empty date_raw is preserved despite the printed dating clause.
